ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the visible surface area, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark base; high-frequency distribution of white point-clusters scattered non-uniformly across both lobes; distinct concentration of high-intensity pixels along the distal trailing edges and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression approximately 40 degrees; vertex partially obscured by low-intensity water spray/pixels at the central base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central-to-distal trailing edge; presence of irregular jagged peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude variations) specifically on the outer-left trailing margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition ending in sharply upturned, vertically-oriented tips; left lobe exhibits a more pronounced vertical sweep than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) across both lobes; highest spatial frequency located on the left medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct vertical-to-diagonal high-intensity linear marks on the left lobe; three parallel faint linear streaks visible on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Tattered/irregular trailing edge with multiple micro-indentations; sharp, hook-like upward orientation of the distal tips possibly indicating previous trauma or structural variation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical projection of the fluke tips relative to the horizontal plane of the lobe body.
